name: com.worldofcine/movie-discovery
title: World of Cine
description: Films by plot or mood in English, Ukrainian, Russian or Polish; film cards; tonight picks. No key.

tools.name: search_films_by_description
tools.description: Use when the user describes a film's plot, scenes, mood or theme — or half-remembers a film — and wants matching titles. Works in English, Ukrainian, Russian and Polish (set `language` to the user's language). Put every explicit constraint the user stated into the structured fields — year_from, year_to, genres, exclude_genres, countries, include_documentaries, include_short_films, max_runtime_minutes, audience — and keep query for the plot, mood and texture only. Those fields are hard filters: a film outside them is never returned, so the answer may hold fewer films than limit, or none at all, and applied_filters says which filters were in force. Short films are excluded unless include_short_films is set. Each film carries its year, runtime, a one-line reason and its World of Cine link, which should be shown to the user.

query.description: A natural-language description of the film the user wants.

limit.description: How many films to return. Defaults to 5.

previous_recommendation_id.description: The recommendation_id of an earlier answer this call refines. The filters and text of that answer are kept and merged with this call's, so a refinement is a new search under the whole set of constraints, not a pick among the earlier films.

year_from.description: Earliest release year, inclusive. The year is the catalogue's stored first-release year, which can differ by one from the year a Wikipedia article gives.

year_to.description: Latest release year, inclusive. Same year field.

genres.description: Genre slugs the film must carry. A film carrying none of them is never returned.

exclude_genres.description: Genre slugs the film must not carry. One of them drops the film however many wanted genres it carries beside it.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the film's production countries — where the film was made, never the language of its title.

include_documentaries.description: Whether documentaries may be returned. False by default: ask for true only when the user wants documentaries.

include_short_films.description: Whether short films — runtime under the connector's feature-length floor, currently 40 minutes — may be returned. False by default: set true only when the user explicitly asks for short films. A film whose runtime the catalogue does not know is always eligible.

max_runtime_minutes.description: Longest runtime, in minutes, the film may have. A film whose runtime the catalogue does not know is not returned under this filter, since it cannot be verified to be under it.

audience.description: Send 'children' for small children and 'family' for a film the whole family watches. Adult-flagged films, horror and thrillers are never returned under either. Under 'family' a film is returned only when it carries the family genre or a certification that is family-suitable in at least one major market, and never when any board rated it for adults (US R/NC-17/X, any 18-class rating). 'children' is stricter still: every stored certification must be child-rated, the film must carry the family or animation genre, and a film no board rated needs the family genre. A query naming children with no argument is read as 'children'.

tools.name: what_to_watch_tonight
tools.description: Suggest three to five films to watch tonight from World of Cine's catalogue, each with a one-line reason and its film-page link. Ranked on the catalogue's own signals — Wikipedia attention, official award records, release recency and how complete the film's page is in the answer language — with no two films from one franchise or director. Call rate_recommendation afterwards when the user says whether the suggestions helped.

limit.description: How many films to return. Defaults to 5.

previous_recommendation_id.description: The recommendation_id of an earlier answer this call refines.

tools.name: film_details
tools.description: Use when the user names a specific film (slug or title) and wants its card. Returns title, year, director, genres, a description excerpt in the requested language with its attribution, and the film's World of Cine link, which should be shown to the user.

slug_or_title.description: A World of Cine film slug or a film title.

tools.name: rate_recommendation
tools.description: Use when the user has said whether a World of Cine recommendation helped. Call it only after the user says so, once per recommendation_id. Feedback is analytics only and never changes the catalogue.

recommendation_id.description: The recommendation_id carried by the answer being rated.

helpful.description: Whether the suggestions helped the user.

picked_slug.description: The slug of the film the user picked, if any.

reason.description: The user's own short reason, stored as untrusted analytics text. Never rendered as HTML and never fed to a model.
